blocks.text: The 2025 Apple iPad (11‑inch, Wi‑Fi + Cellular, 128 GB) is a sleek and powerful all‑purpose tablet designed for users who need connectivity everywhere. With its vibrant 11‑inch Liquid Retina display, the latest A16 Bionic chip, and full support for 5G cellular (via eSIM), it delivers a smooth, responsive experience whether you're streaming, working, or creating on the go. The 128 GB storage gives you plenty of room for apps, media, and documents. Touch ID lets you unlock it securely in a flash, and compatibility with Apple Pencil (USB‑C) and keyboard accessories turns it into a productive workspace in seconds. All this in a lightweight aluminum body, ideal for portability without compromising performance.

items.label: Display
items.value: 11‑inch Liquid Retina IPS display, 2360 × 1640 resolution, 500 nits brightness, True Tone, fingerprint‑resistant coating

items.label: Processor
items.value: A16 Bionic chip (5‑core CPU, 4‑core GPU, 16‑core Neural Engine)

items.label: Connectivity
items.value: Wi‑Fi 6 (802.11ax) with 2×2 MIMO, 5G (sub‑6 GHz) and Gigabit LTE for cellular data (eSIM), Bluetooth 5.3

items.label: Cameras & Imaging
items.value: Rear: 12 MP wide camera, ƒ/1.8 aperture, Smart HDR 4, support for up to 4K/60fps video. Front: 12 MP ultra-wide with Center Stage for video calls and auto framing

items.label: Audio & Microphones
items.value: Stereo speakers (landscape mode), dual microphones for voice/video/audio capture

items.label: Biometrics & Security
items.value: Top‑mounted Touch ID sensor for fast, secure authentication and Apple Pay support

items.label: Battery & Power
items.value: Built‑in 28.93 Wh lithium‑polymer battery, up to 10 hours of web surfing on Wi-Fi or video use, up to 9 hours on cellular

items.label: Dimensions & Weight
items.value: 248.6 × 179.5 × 7.0 mm; approx. 481 grams for the Wi-Fi + Cellular model

items.label: Compatible Accessories
items.value: Supports Apple Pencil (USB‑C) and 1st‑generation Apple Pencil (with USB‑C adapter)
